description: Build the developer dashboard page at apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/developer/page.tsx with 4 tabs (Bridge Analytics, Bot Analytics, Bot Errors, Website Errors). Use recharts for visualization, @radix-ui/react-tabs for tabs, and existing UI components (GlassCard, AnimatedCounter). Fetch data from the 5 API routes created in FEAT-002.
steps: Create apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/developer/page.tsx: async Server Component. Fetch initial data from all 5 API routes using guildId from params. Pass initialData to a client component. The page should be wrapped with SERVER_ADMIN permission check (fetch user session and role via withPermission pattern or redirect if not authorized).

Create apps/web/src/components/developer/DeveloperDashboard.tsx: 'use client' component. Accept initialData as props. Use @radix-ui/react-tabs to create 4 tabs: 'Bridge Analytics', 'Bot Analytics', 'Bot Errors', 'Website Errors'. Each tab renders a separate component.

Create apps/web/src/components/developer/BridgeAnalyticsTab.tsx: display BridgeHealthCheck data. Show status for each component (outbox-worker, discord-bot) with StatusPulse component. Show latency, last checked time, and metadata. Use GlassCard for layout. Add a recharts LineChart showing health checks over time (x=checkedAt, y=status as numeric: healthy=1, degraded=0.5, down=0).

Create apps/web/src/components/developer/BotAnalyticsTab.tsx: display bot command metrics. Show KPIs: total commands (AnimatedCounter), unique command types, top 10 commands (recharts BarChart with metricName on Y, count on X). Show avg response time if available. Use GlassCard for KPI cards.

Create apps/web/src/components/developer/BotErrorsTab.tsx: display ErrorLog data where source='bot'. Use @tanstack/react-table (already installed) to render a table with columns: timestamp, errorType, message, commandName (from metadata), actions (expand to see stack trace). Use GlassCard wrapper. Add pagination controls.

Create apps/web/src/components/developer/WebsiteErrorsTab.tsx: display ErrorLog data where source='api'. Same table structure as BotErrorsTab. Columns: timestamp, errorType, message, endpoint (from metadata), actions (expand for stack).

Style all components using Tailwind classes matching the existing dashboard pattern (see apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/dashboard/page.tsx and apps/web/src/components/analytics/AnalyticsDashboard.tsx). Use VIOLET (#7c3aed) and CYAN (#06b6d4) for charts, GRID_COLOR rgba(255,255,255,0.05), AXIS_COLOR #94a3b8.

Add navigation link to the developer dashboard in apps/web/src/components/ui/Navigation.tsx: only visible to SERVER_ADMIN users. Link text: 'Developer', href: `/servers/[guildId]/developer`, icon: Code or Terminal from lucide-react.
Commit all dashboard page and components with message 'feat(web): add developer dashboard page with 4 tabs for bridge/bot/error analytics'
acceptance_criteria: The /servers/[guildId]/developer page loads and displays 4 tabs
Bridge Analytics tab shows health status for worker and bot with a status chart
Bot Analytics tab shows command metrics with KPI cards and a top commands bar chart
Bot Errors tab shows a paginated table of bot error logs with expandable stack traces
Website Errors tab shows a paginated table of API error logs
Navigation includes a 'Developer' link visible only to SERVER_ADMIN users
All styles match the existing dashboard aesthetic (glass cards, accent colors, etc.)
All changes are committed to git
verification: Run `pnpm --filter web dev`, navigate to /servers/<testGuildId>/developer as a SERVER_ADMIN user, confirm the page loads without errors
Click each tab and confirm data is rendered correctly
Execute a bot command to generate SystemMetric entries, refresh the Bot Analytics tab, confirm the new command appears in the top commands chart
Trigger a bot error, refresh the Bot Errors tab, confirm the error appears in the table
Check the navigation sidebar, confirm the 'Developer' link is present and navigates correctly
Run `git status` and confirm no uncommitted changes
